nodes.title: Add retry with backoff to the sync client
[web] Fix the date picker on small screens
Migrate the settings page to the new form components

pr view https://github.com/acme/web/pull.title: Add retry with backoff to the sync client
pr view https://github.com/acme/web/pull.body:
## What

The sync client gave up on the first failed request. It now retries with **exponential backoff**, see [the guide](https://example.com/retries).

- `SyncClient.send` retries up to 5 times
- Delay doubles from 200 ms

```ts
const delay = Math.min(base * 2 ** attempt, 30_000);
```

| Setting | Default |
| --- | --- |
| base | 200 ms |

pulls/482/comments.body: Should the jitter be full or equal?
Equal jitter keeps a floor on the delay.
